n3448e49af7.summary: Azerbaijan is preparing a support mechanism to expand non-oil and gas exports, with the state to cover part of logistics costs. The measure follows a decree signed by President Ilham Aliyev on June 9.
n3448e49af7.why: Azerbaijan's economy depends heavily on oil and gas, so diversifying exports is a central policy goal for investors tracking the country.

n79f42b2917.summary: Gold moved higher to a more than three-month high, taking its cues primarily from a softer US dollar. Traders are awaiting US inflation data and a speech by the Federal Reserve chair.
n79f42b2917.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and is priced in US dollars, so it tends to respond to dollar moves and to expectations for US inflation and interest rates set by the Federal Reserve.

nab20d1fc39.why: KPMG is a major professional services firm, and its Australian consulting business depends heavily on public-sector work.

n5da0645e71.headline: China ‘actively committed’ to US-Iran peace talks as tensions rise
n5da0645e71.summary: China's commitment comes shortly before Washington is due to unveil plans to economically isolate Iran on August 24.

ne95156f053.headline: Oil falls as US prepares to unveil new Iran sanctions
ne95156f053.summary: Oil prices slipped more than $1 a barrel on Monday as investors took profits ahead of an expected Washington announcement on new Iran sanctions. Such sanctions may further disrupt Middle East supplies.
ne95156f053.why: Crude oil is the main global energy commodity, and Brent and WTI prices feed into fuel costs, inflation and company margins worldwide. Iran is a significant oil exporter, so sanctions can tighten supply.
ne95156f053.why_moved: Traders took profits ahead of an expected US announcement of new Iran sanctions. The prospect of further supply disruption from the Middle East was the backdrop to the move.

na1c2e37823.headline: Bessent launches 'Operation Economic Outcast' targeting Iran's global lifelines
na1c2e37823.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the Trump administration aims to sever every economic lifeline sustaining Iran's government. The campaign is framed as an economic operation against Iran.
na1c2e37823.why: Sanctions targeting Iran's revenue and trade channels can affect global oil flows, shipping and companies with Iran exposure.

n68eecb89ee.headline: Stocks extend losses late Monday morning on chip profit-taking
n68eecb89ee.summary: Seoul stocks extended losses late Monday morning as investors locked in profits from large-cap technology shares, including semiconductors. The benchmark index was lower.
n68eecb89ee.why: South Korea's equity market is heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers, so chip-sector moves strongly influence the index.
n68eecb89ee.why_moved: Investors locked in profits from large-cap technology and semiconductor shares, extending losses in the benchmark index.

n3f8db2445d.headline: DBS, IBF sign first MOU on AI skills for finance sector
n3f8db2445d.summary: DBS has signed an agreement with the Institute of Banking and Finance to develop skills and workforce programmes for Singapore's financial sector. The move responds to AI reshaping jobs and work practices.
n3f8db2445d.why: DBS is Southeast Asia's largest bank by assets, and workforce skills in AI affect banks' productivity and costs.

n5a9ba918f7.headline: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveils new U.S. economic sanctions to isolate Iran
n5a9ba918f7.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced new US economic sanctions to isolate Iran, which the administration called an "economic D-Day". Iran vowed a "seismic" response.
n5a9ba918f7.why: US sanctions restrict Iran's access to dollar finance and oil export revenue, which can tighten global crude supply and raise energy prices.
n5a9ba918f7.why_moved: The sanctions escalate the US-Iran standoff, raising the risk of disruption to oil flows from the Middle East.

n5b57143fc0.headline: PSEi inches up on late-session bargain hunting
n5b57143fc0.summary: The PSEi closed higher on Monday, supported by late-session bargain hunting. Sentiment had been weighed on earlier in the session.
n5b57143fc0.why: The PSEi is the benchmark index of the Philippine Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

n9a3ffef1f7.headline: Bessent says US-Iran war entering 'endgame,' will sever all economic lifelines | The Jerusalem Post
n9a3ffef1f7.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US-Iran war is entering its endgame and will sever all economic lifelines. He warned that any remaining ties to Tehran would hasten economic ostracism.
n9a3ffef1f7.why: The US Treasury administers sanctions that restrict access to the dollar system, affecting global trade, energy flows and commodity markets.

n65c2974d13.headline: US vows 'economic D-Day' as Iran threatens to halt all oil exports
n65c2974d13.summary: The US threatened Iran with what it called 'the greatest financial offensive ever marshalled.' Iran has threatened to halt all oil exports, according to the report.
n65c2974d13.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and any disruption to its exports affects global crude supply and prices. Sanctions and financial measures shape how much Iranian oil reaches the market.
n65c2974d13.why_moved: The US threat of a financial offensive against Iran and Iran's threat to halt all oil exports raise the risk of lower Iranian supply.

nc76228ce5c.headline: Oil markets to remain tight as conflicts drag on
nc76228ce5c.summary: Ampol, which owns one of Australia's two onshore oil refineries, reported a stellar first-half profit as conflicts keep oil markets tight.
nc76228ce5c.why: Ampol is Australia's largest fuel retailer and refiner, and its margins reflect refining economics and fuel supply conditions in the country.

nf69eb72c69.headline: Either with us or against us: US warns of ‘economic D Day’; Iran calls threats ‘desperate’ - BusinessToday
nf69eb72c69.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said any country that tethers itself to Iran will face economic consequences and isolation. Iran called the threats 'desperate'.
nf69eb72c69.why: Sanctions and trade measures tied to the US-Iran conflict can shift oil flows, shipping routes and capital allocation across global markets.
nf69eb72c69.why_moved: Threats of economic consequences for countries aligned with Iran raise the risk of sanctions and disruption to energy and trade flows.

nb4ecf8e50f.headline: Scandal-hit KPMG Australia to cut nearly 400 jobs, warns of difficult market
nb4ecf8e50f.summary: KPMG Australia plans to cut about 5% of its workforce, affecting 27 partners and around 360 employees. The firm reported a 1% fall in annual revenue to A$2.257 billion.
nb4ecf8e50f.why: KPMG is one of the Big Four professional services firms. Its results signal demand trends in consulting and government advisory work.

n286c55805d.headline: Iran official says support for new sanctions would be 'act of war,' other Middle East news
n286c55805d.summary: The new head of Iran's top security body warned that Tehran would view any country's support for new US economic measures against Iran as an act of war.
n286c55805d.why: Sanctions on Iran affect oil exports and shipping, and threats of escalation can move energy and regional risk markets.

n23b034814e.headline: US set to unveil Iran sanctions as Tehran threatens oil blockade
n23b034814e.summary: The head of Iran's top security body warned that any country supporting new US economic measures against Iran would be regarded as committing an act of war. The US is set to unveil the sanctions.
n23b034814e.why: Sanctions on Iran's oil sector and threats to Gulf shipping influence global crude supply and prices.
n23b034814e.why_moved: The threat of an oil blockade and planned new US sanctions on Iran raise the risk of reduced Gulf oil supply.

nb05ff6ebce.headline: 'Economy is the regime's Achilles' heel': Expert weighs in on financial war against Iran

nb05ff6ebce.why: Restricting access to the international financial system affects a country's ability to trade, settle payments and attract capital.

na912a0e4a2.headline: Exxon Holds Firm as Iranian Oil Exports Collapse
na912a0e4a2.summary: Exxon is preserving its position this week, while Iranian oil exports have collapsed, according to Yahoo Finance. The report gave few further details.
na912a0e4a2.why: Exxon Mobil is one of the largest publicly traded oil companies, and its results are sensitive to crude prices and global supply.

n58ed16eb11.headline: Trump’s ‘economic D-Day’ threats become warnings for countries to sever financial ties with Iran
n58ed16eb11.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a new round of sanctions aimed at Iran on Monday and warned every country doing business with Iran about its financial ties.
n58ed16eb11.why: US sanctions can restrict banks and companies worldwide from dealing with Iran, affecting trade flows, energy supply and emerging-market exposure.

ne75cd0dad6.headline: Mediator to hold talks in Iran on US 'economic D-Day'
ne75cd0dad6.summary: Pakistan's army chief is in Tehran seeking to revive mediation to end the war between Iran and Washington. Talks are reportedly focused on an 'economic D-Day' proposal.
ne75cd0dad6.why: The US-Iran conflict affects global oil supply, shipping routes and sanctions regimes that investors track across energy and emerging markets.

nbc4282a09a.headline: Central Bank of Sri Lanka Launches Search for Liquidators to Wind Up Failed Financial Institutions
nbc4282a09a.summary: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has begun a formal process to identify and appoint qualified liquidators to wind up troubled banks and financial institutions.

n96f5d21354.headline: Bessent says Treasury auctions will continue as usual despite expanded buyback program
n96f5d21354.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said auctions will continue as scheduled while a new buyback structure for longer-dated securities takes effect on Sept. 9.
n96f5d21354.why: Treasury auctions and buybacks shape supply and pricing of US government debt, which underpins global bond markets.

n5dfbbac598.headline: Xiaomi launches new Xring chip, partners with TSMC for production
n5dfbbac598.summary: Xiaomi launched its Xring O3 chip, made with TSMC, as it pushes to develop its own smartphone chips and compete with Apple, Samsung and Huawei.
n5dfbbac598.why: Xiaomi is a major Chinese smartphone maker, and in-house chip design affects its cost structure and competitive position.

n917a8fe2df.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a new round of sanctions aimed at Iran on Monday and warned every country that does business with Iran.
n917a8fe2df.why: US Treasury sanctions can restrict access to the dollar system for firms and banks that deal with a sanctioned country.

n1628775f49.headline: Rupee falls 3 paise to close at 95.74 against US dollar
n1628775f49.summary: The Indian rupee settled at 95.74 per US dollar on a provisional basis, after touching an intraday low of 95.75. It opened at 95.65.
n1628775f49.why: The rupee's exchange rate against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in Indian assets.

n8a96dba9ff.headline: JD.com makes commitments in the MediaMarkt acquisition case
n8a96dba9ff.summary: JD.com is reported to have offered remedies to the European Union in its investigation into its acquisition of Ceconomy, parent of MediaMarkt and Saturn.
n8a96dba9ff.why: JD.com is a major Chinese e-commerce company, and EU merger reviews can shape the terms and timing of its European retail deals.

n4beed48003.headline: Southeast Asia's budget airlines eye recovery but fuel scars linger
n4beed48003.summary: Southeast Asia's budget carriers hope the worst of the Middle East-driven fuel shock is behind them. Analysts expect margins to stay under pressure and household budgets to weigh on demand.
n4beed48003.why: Budget airlines are highly sensitive to jet fuel costs, which can represent a large share of their operating expenses. Demand depends heavily on household incomes.

nfdb2844130.headline: Haryana Government Signs Industrial Investment Proposals Worth Over ₹66,000 Crore, Boosting State’s Industrial Growth Agenda
nfdb2844130.summary: Haryana signed MoUs for industrial investment proposals worth over Rs 66,000 crore, with Chief Minister Saini highlighting policy stability, faster approvals and infrastructure.

nc196ab0e90.headline: Avaada Electro May File For $800 Million IPO This Month

nc196ab0e90.why: Avaada Electro makes solar cells and modules in India, and large listings in renewable manufacturing signal capital flows into the sector.

n4ae47720f2.headline: Finance Minister unveils $1.2 bil debt swap to tackle NCDs, childhood obesity
n4ae47720f2.summary: Barbados' finance minister unveiled a planned $1.2 billion debt-for-social swap in December. Savings from the transaction would be directed to tackling the country's non-communicable disease crisis, including childhood obesity.
n4ae47720f2.why: Debt-for-social swaps restructure sovereign debt in exchange for spending commitments, affecting government borrowing costs and creditor arrangements.

n882b226cb0.summary: Nvidia customers face AI server price hikes of more than 15% as memory costs soar. Nvidia can charge tens of thousands of dollars per chip because supply cannot meet demand.

nd8be9b0fe4.summary: The Philippine government is allocating about P7.5 billion to reduce nontechnical electricity losses. It is also developing a plan to address technical losses.

n92140c20c0.headline: Filipinos just above poverty line remain vulnerable

nfff476ea71.headline: Early action may curb El Niño inflation
